Name: Mouse Fishing
Author: ruggerbuns
Description:
[size=4][b][color=#ffff00]Fish with your mouse cursor![/color]

[color=#e69138]This mod allows you to use your [/color][color=#1e84cc]mouse cursor[/color][color=#e69138] to control the [/color][color=#00ff00]green bobber bar[/color][color=#e69138] during the [/color][color=#ffff00]fishing minigame[/color][color=#e69138].[/color]
[color=#e69138]All you have to do is [/color][color=#00ff00]follow the fish[/color][color=#e69138] with [/color][color=#1e84cc]your mouse[/color][color=#e69138] to catch it.[/color]

[b][color=#e69138]You'll notice that the [/color][color=#00ff00]green bobber bar[/color][color=#e69138] is smaller than normal, this is to ensure that [/color][color=#ffff00]fishing remains challenging[/color][color=#e69138].[/color]
[color=#e69138]You can adjust the [/color][color=#00ff00]green bobber bar's[/color][color=#e69138] height [/color][b][color=#e69138]by installing [/color][color=#616161][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][u]Generic Mod Config Menu[/u][/url][/color][/b][color=#e69138][b][color=#e69138][b][color=#e69138].[/color][/b][/color]
[/b]
